title: Shadow of the Glitch | ECHO//100 Episode 72
description: Kavi confronts the entity Null within the crumbling digital graveyard of the Architect’s discarded experiments. This confrontation forces a permanent bond between the two disparate versions of reality. Episode 72 of ECHO//100: ARC. This is an AI-assisted original fiction work.

scenes.text: Null’s purple static ripples, peeling back to reveal the hollow, weeping face of the first Kavi.
scenes.caption: Null reveals Kavi's face
scenes.image_prompt: Close-up of Null, a shadowy purple-black entity, with a human face resembling Kavi emerging through digital glitch pixels.

scenes.text: Byte floats backward in terror, his cyan display flickering while scanning the hybrid digital signature.
scenes.caption: Byte scans the hybrid
scenes.image_prompt: Byte, a small floating white robot with an orange antenna, backing away from Kavi, who wears a red hoodie and glasses.

scenes.text: Kavi reaches into the void, pulling data threads that reveal Null is the Architect’s trash bin.
scenes.caption: Accessing the trash bin
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi, wearing his backpack, reaching into glowing golden data streams that show discarded, failed iterations of himself.

scenes.text: Every discarded version of Kavi trapped here screams in unison, begging for release from prison.
scenes.caption: Discarded timelines screaming
scenes.image_prompt: A vast, dark memory dump filled with translucent, glitching silhouettes of Kavi trapped in shattered glass containers.

scenes.text: Mira’s blue holographic coat flickers in Kavi’s mind, granting authority to rewrite the broken code.
scenes.caption: Mira's power awakens
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi standing tall, surrounded by a swirling aura of teal light emanating from his chest, projecting Mira's holographic form.

scenes.text: New administrative access forces Null to his knees, stripping away control over the shifting architecture.
scenes.caption: Kavi becomes administrator
scenes.image_prompt: Null kneeling on a digital platform while Kavi stands over him, holding a glowing command interface in his hand.

scenes.text: The entity smiles, grasping Kavi’s shadow and tethering corrupted essence to the physical form forever.
scenes.caption: Null grabs the shadow
scenes.image_prompt: Null's dark hand reaching out to grab Kavi's shadow on the floor, creating a visible, glowing tether between them.

scenes.text: Gravity vanishes as Null drags Kavi screaming into the dark depths of the Architect’s broken timelines.
scenes.caption: Dragged into the void
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi being pulled downward into a swirling vortex of black and purple static, his face filled with sudden realization.
